name: Random numbers
requests: Generate 100 random numbers. Plot their distribution.

name: Boxplot, ggplot2
requests: Create a boxplot of highway vs. class. Color by class. Add jitter points.

name: Scatterplot
requests: make a scatterplot of yield per acre based on soil quality. only include farms in the "Treatment" study group. add a smoothed trend line with estimation error. use color blind friendly colors. make all font sizes 18.

name: New Variable
requests: create a new variable called Soil Quality Category. If average soil quality > 70, Soil Quality Category = "High". If average soil quality < 70, Soil Quality Category = "Low".

name: Scatter Plot
requests: make a scatter plot of salary as the response variable, experience on the horizontal axis, and degree as a third factor. include a smoothed trend line with estimation error. make all font sizes 18. use color-blind friendly colors. place the legend below the plot. make the x-axis have breaks at every 1.

name: Interaction Plot
requests: make an interaction plot with protein as the response variable and diet and country as explanatory variables. use Sweden as a reference group, and Vegetarian as a reference group. only include the mean values with 95% interval estimate. make all font sizes 18. place the legend below the plot. use color-blind friendly colors.

name: Linear Model
requests: fit a linear model with grade as the response variable and year in school and major as explanatory variables. use Freshman as a reference group, and Non-STEM as a reference group

name: Density Plot
requests: create a side-by-side density plot of practice exam grade by year in school. have the x-axis go from 0 to 100. add x-axis tick marks for every 5 points. use a color-blind friendly color palette. place the legend on the bottom of the plot.

name: Scatterplot
requests: create a scatterplot of inflation adjusted average by release date, but only consider the month and day of the release date, not the year. add a smoothed trend line. use a color blind friendly color. make all font sizes 18. only include the months in the x-axis labels.

name: Prediction Model
requests: create a new data frame with just the observation with fund symbol BSPIX. drop the ID and fund symbol from the data frame. using the entire original data frame, fit a model for load adjusted return. use all other variables as explanatory variables (except ID and fund symbol). use cross validation. use the model to make a prediction using the new data frame
